review_cost.rationale: All requested changes are nits; the architecture and framework usage are sound and I'd approve after one pass of small fixes.

findings.issue: The 150ms search debounce calls update() from a stale render closure: if a Type/Generation select changes inside the window, the pending search pushes the old filter values to the URL (and the select's update uses lastPushed q, dropping pending typed text).
findings.suggestion: Read the current params from searchParams at debounce-fire time (or keep filters in a ref), and clear the pending debounce in update() when another filter fires first.

findings.issue: In-memory cache never evicts expired entries — the TTL only gates reuse, so the Map grows to the full API surface (species ids, ~900 moves, version groups, evolution chains) for the life of the server process.
findings.suggestion: Delete entries on expiry (e.g. lazy sweep on access) or cap the cache with an LRU.

findings.issue: The shared Card view-model type lives in the server-only ~/lib/api.server module and is type-imported into client components; a future value import (e.g. spriteUrl) would break the server/client boundary the .server.ts convention is meant to enforce.
findings.suggestion: Move shared shapes (Card, NamedRef, MoveRow-style view models) to ~/lib/types.ts and keep api.server.ts for transport only.

findings.issue: God data module: transport + caching + API type definitions + localization helpers + card view-model construction in one file that all four routes import.
findings.suggestion: Split into api.server.ts (fetch/cache), types.ts (API + view-model shapes) and a small localization module.

findings.issue: The label fallback closure typeNames[name] ?? humanize(name) is duplicated in pokemon.tsx, move.tsx:19 and type.tsx:21.
findings.suggestion: Have getTypeNames() (or a shared helper) return a labelFor() function and reuse it.

findings.issue: The ErrorBoundary branches on the string 'Not found' produced by errorHeading rather than the error's status.
findings.suggestion: Check isRouteErrorResponse(error) and compare status === 404 inside ErrorBoundary, or return a boolean alongside the heading.

findings.issue: The loaderData ? pageTitle(...) : "Not found – Pokédex" fallbacks here and in move.tsx/type.tsx/ability.tsx are dead code — meta doesn't run for a route whose loader threw; root meta already covers the 404 title (root.tsx:17-18).
findings.suggestion: Drop the null branches; keep the 404 title logic solely in root meta.

findings.issue: getTypeNames() fetches all 18 full type records (each embedding its complete pokemon list) just to build a name→English-name map used on every detail page.
findings.suggestion: Build the label map from the type list + names without pulling each full record, or cache the derived map once.

findings.issue: The catch-all route's component returns null and all UI comes from the root ErrorBoundary — functional but non-obvious to a reader expecting a Not Found page here.
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line comment stating the 404 page renders via the root ErrorBoundary, or render the heading/link here directly.

summary: Clean, current-idiom React Router v8 framework-mode code: typed route modules, documented 404/error-boundary patterns and URL-driven loaders, with only minor hand-rolled pieces. The main asks before merge are fixing the search-debounce stale-closure race, bounding the API cache, and splitting the god data module so the shared Card type stops crossing the server/client boundary. Everything else is nits — I'd merge after one small pass.
